fullContentHtml:
Bihar BTSC Staff Nurse Result / Cutoff 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC) has released the Result / Cutoff for the post of Staff Nurse. This recruitment was released for 11389 posts. The applications for Bihar BTSC Staff Nurse Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 25 April 2025 to 13 June 2025. The written examination was held on 30, 31 July & 01, 03 August 2025. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their Bihar BTSC Staff Nurse Result 2026 from the link given below...

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 25 April 2025
  • Application Start Date : 25 April 2025
  • Last Date : 13 June 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 13 June 2025
  • Exam Date : 30, 31 July & 01, 03 August 2025
  • Admit Card : 23 July 2025
  • Answer Key : 08 August 2025
  • Result : 11 December 2025
  • DV List Available : 10 April 2026
  • DV Admit Card Available : 16 April 2026
  • DV Objection : 25-29 July 2026
  • Result / Cutoff : 27 August 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, BC, EBC : Rs. 600/-
  • Other State (All Category) : Rs.600/-
  • SC, ST, EBC of Bihar : Rs.150/-
  • All Female of Bihar : Rs.150/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
